name: A Good Friend
summary: At Aldrassil, Dirania Silvershine grows worried when Iverron misses his daily visit. She asks travelers to search the hills near Shadowthread Cave, north of Shadowglen.

sections.title: A Missing Visitor
sections.body: Dirania Silvershine waits beneath Aldrassil for Iverron, who visits her every day. Hours pass without him, and she asks travelers heading into Shadowglen to look for her friend.

sections.title: Peril at Shadowthread Cave
sections.body: Iverron often wanders the hills in northern Shadowglen, near the webwood spiders of Shadowthread Cave. The spiders make the surrounding slopes dangerous for travelers. Search west of the cave entrance, where Iverron is hiding and needs help.

faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf who lives beneath Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Iverron visits her every day, so she notices when he fails to arrive.
Iverron is a night elf who wanders the hills near Shadowthread Cave in Shadowglen. He misses his daily visit to Dirania Silvershine and is found on the cliffs west of the cave entrance.
Iverron is hiding on the hillside just west of the entrance to Shadowthread Cave, in northern Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why is the northern cave considered dangerous?
faq.answer: Venomous webwood spiders overrun Shadowthread Cave and its surrounding slopes. The spreading corruption on Teldrassil has agitated them, making the area dangerous for travelers alone.
After you find Iverron, he tells you that his misadventure near the spider cave has left him in dire straits. A search for treatment begins with A Friend in Need.

faq.q: Why was Dirania so quick to worry about Iverron?
faq.answer: Iverron visits Dirania at the same hour every day. When he is several hours late, and she knows he often wanders near the dangerous spider hollows, she fears something has happened to him.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei beneath Aldrassil, you can answer Dirania's call and see how the glade's growing dangers touch its people.
As a druid, you may recognize the aggressive webwood spiders near Shadowthread Cave as a sign of the wider corruption afflicting the great bough.
